compile_method: Sequential builds; dependency downloads/tool installation excluded; fresh project object/cache directories; warm downloaded source/toolchain caches. Three no-op and three main-file comment-edit rebuilds after one clean build per variant.

compile.config: Rust application on ESP-IDF 5.5.3; release opt-level=s, thin LTO; C SDK size/-Os

runtime_method: One physical ESP32-S3 v0.2 SP140, USB only, ESC/motor disconnected. 10 s warmup, three ~9.5 s disarmed idle windows, then three ~9.5 s forced whole-screen redraw windows. Counts actual LVGL final flushes and SPI pixels; screen is 160x128 RGB565. Idle UI-loop rate is not FPS. SPI values are configured clocks. No intentional BLE client traffic. All application tasks and physical BLE initialization enabled.

limitations: Clean builds are single samples with warm downloaded dependencies; no-op and comment-only main-file edit times are medians of three.
SDK/compiler/optimization settings and display buffer sizes differ; these compare current implementations, not an isolated Rust-language speedup.
Rust uses one 16-row synchronous draw buffer to fit physical internal RAM; C++ uses two 64-row buffers.
Rust control worker runs at 100 Hz with a 50 Hz ESC throttle cadence; C++ control task is 50 Hz. Wall time includes blocking waits and is not CPU utilization.
Disarmed bench measurements do not validate connected ESC/BMS traffic, motor timing, radio pairing/OTA under load, or flight readiness.

native: Handle the IDF 5.5 not-installed TWAI status code and guard throttle before initialization.
Serialize diagnostic history one record at a time; prevent background console logs interleaving it without blocking the throttle task.
Use the current IDF I2C master driver after a physical legacy-I2C interrupt watchdog was captured.
Route SDK stdio through the installed USB interrupt driver.
rust: Set the Bosch callback context required by its API.
Release the startup task after spawning workers.
Use a bounded single display buffer for the synchronous panel.
Allocate completed CAN payloads on demand without reducing queue/payload limits; avoid allocations when polling an empty queue.
Stream diagnostic history one record at a time.
Match ST7735 rotation commands to the retained driver.
Release the diagnostics mutex before serial output so USB backpressure cannot delay the watchdog snapshot.
